senses.gloss:
जोष जोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. जुष्), satisfac-
tion, approval, pleasure, enjoyment, felicity, happiness;
(जोषम् आ, Ved. to one's satisfaction, abundantly;
अनु जोषम्, according to one's pleasure, willingly);
(अम्), ind. according to one's wish or liking, happily,
with ease, without effort; well; silently; जोषम्
आस्, to remain quiet or silent; जोषम् आस्स्व, be
thou quiet, keep thou silent; [cf. अ-जोष.]
—जोष-
वाक, अस्, m., Ved. unintelligible words, chattering
nonsense; (Sāy.) words which ought to please but
do not.
जोषा जोषा, f. = योषा, a woman.

जोषयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made dear or
agreeable, to be reflected upon or thought about,
obscure, unintelligible (in words).

जोषयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, or जोष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ,
loving, cherishing, fostering, taking care of; (Sāy.)
serving.
जोषस् in वि-जोषस्, स-जोषस्, q. v.

जोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. delightful, agreeable, wel-
come, satisfactory.

जोषिका जोषिका, f. = जालिका, a cluster of
young buds, a bud, a germ.

जोषित् जोषित् or जोषिता, f. = योषित्, a
woman.
